title: Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery: Surcharge for Repeated Customer Reschedules
content:
Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a customer's reschedule of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment carries a surcharge for the customer's own confirmed reschedule requests already on the order, the request being made not counted, measured against the program's free reschedules, which number 2 for Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery (0 in every other program).

| Confirmed customer reschedule requests already on the order | Above the free reschedules by | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 4 or more | two or more | 15.00 |
| 3 | exactly one | 5.00 |
| 2 or fewer | none | none |

**Question and answer.** *A customer has 3 confirmed reschedule requests on the order and asks for another change — what surcharge does this request carry?* The 3 requests already on the order are one above the 2 free reschedules, so 5.00; the request being made is not counted.
